root_cause: Package 'fake_missing_package' PyPI par exist nahi karta hai, isliye pip install fail ho raha hai
explanation: Commit message me likha hai ki 'fake_missing_package' ko automatically add kiya gaya hai requirements.txt me (line 33 par). Lekin ye package real nahi hai - PyPI repository me ye package available nahi hai. Jab pip install command chala toh wo is package ko dhundh nahi paya aur exit code 1 ke saath fail ho gaya. Ye ek self-healing system ki galti lag rahi hai jo missing dependency detect karke galat package name add kar diya
suggested_fix:
1. requirements.txt ki line 33 se 'fake_missing_package' entry ko remove karo
2. Self-healing automation logic ko review karo jo automatically dependencies add kar raha hai
3. Agar koi real package missing hai toh uska sahi naam identify karke add karo
4. Self-healing system me validation add karo jo PyPI par package existence check kare before adding
